what: The moment-of-truth frame (Issue #331/#345's --demo-moment-of-truth) added to the screenshots stage of scripts/verify.ps1, next to the existing baseline and prepared-raid captures. Captured twice and compared byte-for-byte, the same way capture-evidence.ps1 already treats every capture. Two JSON assertions read off the printed godot_graybox_screenshot event guard what a byte comparison alone cannot: that the frame actually lands on an open window (ui.momentOfTruth.open) and that the band answering it is actually drawn (ui.momentOfTruth.visible).

timing.method: git stash / git stash pop around scripts/verify.ps1 -Stage screenshots, run twice each side with warm dotnet/Godot caches so the comparison is the stage body's own added work and not cold-restore noise. elapsedSeconds is the verification_stage event's own measurement, not a shell-side timer.

before.log: /tmp/verify-screenshots-before2.log (warm-cache run; a cold-cache first run measured 41.9s, discarded as not comparable)

timing.delta: +5.9s (~45%), from two more Godot invocations (primary + repeat capture of the moment-of-truth frame), matching the cost the existing baseline-repeat pair already pays.

whatTheNewAssertionsCatch: Corrected in the rework round after independent review of PR #362 (finding F1): only ui.momentOfTruth.open is confirmed by a mutant that isolates it. Mutant B of evidence/349-mutant.json (CurrentMomentOfTruth() always Closed) reddens the screenshots stage on exactly this assertion — 'The moment-of-truth capture did not land on an open window.' — while leaving the byte comparison, AssertLabelsFit and every other guard green; that is the demonstrated value of adding open. ui.momentOfTruth.visible is read off the live _momentBand node (Main.HudText.cs, MomentOfTruthState) and remains a useful, independent-in-principle check, but no mutant run so far isolates it: mutant A of evidence/349-mutant.json flips exactly the _momentBand.Visible assignment this field reads and is intercepted earlier, by the pre-existing AssertLabelsFit/MeasureMomentOfTruthBand worst-case guard (Main.HudText.cs, shipped with #331/#345 before #349), before the screenshots stage's own assertions ever run. The original wording here claimed visible was 'the one field a regression... can flip independently of everything else staying green' — that claim is false on the evidence in this same file's sibling (evidence/349-mutant.json) and has been removed rather than left standing next to the mutant that contradicts it.
